parameters.query:
WITH sales_data AS (
SELECT
mall_id,
formatDateTime(stat_date, '%Y-%m') AS month,
any(category_name) AS "Category",
sum(total_sales) AS "This_month_sales",
sum(total_paymethod_payed - total_paymethod_refund - (paymethod_cash - paymethod_cash_refund)) AS "This_month_real_sales",
sum(total_paymethod_payed) AS sum_sal
FROM
data_bi_private.dist_sales_daily_stat_03
WHERE
mall_id = '{{ $json.mall_id }}'
AND stat_date >= parseDateTimeBestEffort('{{ $json.startDate }}')
AND stat_date < parseDateTimeBestEffort('{{ $json.endDate }}')
GROUP BY
mall_id, month
)
SELECT
month,
sum_sal
FROM
sales_data
ORDER BY
month;
